components.css: :host{--desk:#e7ebf1;--card:#fdfdfb;--rule:#d6e1ef;--lines:#e8eef6;--margin:#e3897d;--ink:#1b2130;--ink-2:#4d5566;--stamp:#4b3a8f;--stamp-soft:#ece8f7;--red:#b5361f;--red-soft:#fbeae6;--line:#c9d2de;--marker:#ffe27a;font:16px/1.75 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-card{background-color:var(--card);border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(27,33,48,.06),0 8px 24px -12px rgba(27,33,48,.22);padding:28px 26px 28px 58px;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 41px,var(--margin) 41px,var(--margin) 42px,transparent 42px),repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0,transparent 27px,var(--lines) 27px,var(--lines) 28px)} .ds-head{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:26.5px} .ds-head h1{margin:0;font-size:26px;line-height:28px;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:700} .ds-stamp{display:inline-block;margin:0 2px 5px 0;font:600 13px/1.25 ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--stamp);border:1.5px solid var(--stamp);border-radius:3px;padding:5px 9px 4px;transform:rotate(-2deg);text-align:center;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--card),inset 0 0 0 3px var(--stamp)} .ds-stamp b{display:block;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:.04em} .ds-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:0 18px;margin:0;line-height:28px} .ds-facts dt{color:var(--ink-2)} .ds-facts dd{margin:0;font-weight:600} .ds-mark{padding:0 .18em;margin:0 -.1em;border-radius:.25em .6em .35em .5em;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;background:linear-gradient(176deg,transparent 52%,var(--marker) 53%,var(--marker) 90%,transparent 91%)}

components.css: :host{--desk:#e7ebf1;--card:#fdfdfb;--rule:#d6e1ef;--lines:#e8eef6;--margin:#e3897d;--ink:#1b2130;--ink-2:#4d5566;--stamp:#4b3a8f;--stamp-soft:#ece8f7;--red:#b5361f;--red-soft:#fbeae6;--line:#c9d2de;font:16px/1.75 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border:1.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden} .ds-seg label{position:relative;font-weight:500;font-size:13px;text-align:center;line-height:1.3;padding:10px 6px;cursor:pointer;border-left:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:53px} .ds-seg label:first-child{border-left:0} .ds-seg input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px} .ds-seg label:has(input:checked){background:var(--ink);color:var(--card)} .ds-seg label:has(input:focus-visible){outline:2.5px solid var(--stamp);outline-offset:-5px}

components.css: :host{--desk:#e7ebf1;--card:#fdfdfb;--rule:#d6e1ef;--lines:#e8eef6;--margin:#e3897d;--ink:#1b2130;--ink-2:#4d5566;--stamp:#4b3a8f;--stamp-soft:#ece8f7;--red:#b5361f;--red-soft:#fbeae6;--line:#c9d2de;font:16px/1.75 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-record{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse} .ds-record td{padding:0 10px 0 0;vertical-align:top;line-height:28px;box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--rule)} .ds-record .when{font:500 13px/28px ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;color:var(--stamp);white-space:nowrap} .ds-record .what{width:100%} .ds-record small{display:block;color:var(--ink-2);font-size:13px} .ds-undo{font:600 13px/1 inherit;font-family:inherit;padding:7px 12px;min-height:36px;border-radius:4px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s;margin-top:10px} .ds-undo:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--card)} .ds-undo:focus-visible{outline:2.5px solid var(--stamp);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: Every page is a ruled library index card on a cool grey desk: hairline blue rules every 28px, one red margin line. An open vault is lent to an AI app until a time pressed in a violet rubber stamp at the top right; what changed is written line by line on the card. Actions are in ink; red appears only where something cannot be taken back. It refuses the shield-and-badge security dashboard: facts on the card tell the security story. Server-rendered, no scripts, no external requests; light is the default; dark is opt-in through a no-script top-bar switch remembered per browser by cookie.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled card stock on a 28px rule grid with one red margin line
Violet stamp ink for time and focus; ink for actions; red only for the irreversible
System UI type at 13/16/20/26px; mono only for times
One soft card shadow; everything inside is flat
Page titles marked with a yellow highlighter stroke

rules.name: The Red-Means-Loss Rule
rules.body: Irreversible Red appears only on actions that destroy data or on errors. If it can be undone, it is ink.

rules.name: The Two Reds Rule
rules.body: Margin Red rules the paper; Irreversible Red warns. Never swap them.

rules.name: The Softer-Than-Dividers Rule
rules.body: Background rules (lines) stay lighter than row dividers (rule) in both themes; softened at the user's request and kept.

rules.name: The On-The-Rule Rule
rules.body: Every line box and block gap is 28px (26.5px under a 1.5px head rule).

rules.name: The One-Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the card casts a shadow.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Only page titles (h1) get the yellow marker stroke under the lower half of the text; no rule under titles.

dos: Do keep one solid-ink primary action per card.
Do put the due-back time in the violet stamp on the head rule, top right.
Do keep every line box and gap on the 28px rule.
Do keep background rules lighter than row dividers.
Do use only 13/16/20/26px and the system UI font.
Do keep light as the default; dark applies only under :root[data-theme="dark"], chosen through the top-bar switch.
Do keep pages script-free and self-contained.
Do say "Encryptor MCP" wherever the name shows.
Do mark every page title with the highlighter stroke, and only page titles.
donts: Don't use shields, badges, glowing locks, gradients or dashboard tiles.
Don't use Irreversible Red for anything undoable, or Margin Red on a control.
Don't lift anything but the card.
Don't embed or download fonts or load anything from another origin.
Don't preview PDFs in the page; they download only.
Don't follow prefers-color-scheme or switch themes with script.
Don't draw a rule under titles; the highlighter replaced the red head line.
